text:
tara-support: Heads-up — ACME reported a spike where a single user request turned into duplicated token charges on their invoice after a short outage. Dashboard shows 12k tokens for the window, invoice shows ~24k. Customer got charged twice. Ticket 78921.
eli: Ugh. Any request_id or example invoice lines we can tie to a request? Can you paste a raw request/headers from the session?
 tara-support: Yep — customer sent logs. Root request: request_id=rc-9a4f, timestamp=2026-03-12T14:02:11Z. They hit a 504 from our edge for ~350ms, client retried once. Server logs show two downstream ingestion events with same client payload but only one idempotency key arrived downstream (the first). It looks like a partial header strip on the retry path.
 matt_ops: Noted. We saw a short ingress burst then proxy failover around that time in us-west-2 (edge pod rotation). The ingress proxy has two code paths when an upstream is slow: immediate retry fanout vs queued handoff. One of those flows was introduced in the recent edge patch and doesn't copy the X-Idempotency-Key header into the queued replay request.
 sophia-engr: Can you paste the minimal repro curl? Also include header names exactly — sometimes clients use `Idempotency-Key` vs `X-Idempotency-Key` and our proxy canonicalization only preserves the latter.
 tara-support: Here's the snippet the customer provided (sanitized):
 ```
 curl -i \ 
   -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \ 
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
   -H "X-Idempotency-Key: 3f1c-abc-0" \ 
   --data '{"input":"..."}' \
   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
 ```
 They saw the first request 504: `edge=504 upstream_timeout=1.2s` then their sdk retried once automatically. Our ingress logs show two downstream events with the same body but only the first had `x-idempotency-key=3f1c-abc-0`. The second downstream event had idempotency header absent.
 billing-bot: Invoice event linked: invoice_2026_03_12: usage_event(rc-9a4f)-tokens=11980 ; later usage_event(rc-9a4f)-tokens=11980 — two separate usage records recorded 45s apart.
 eli: That matches a replay resulting in two ledger writes. Our metering layer dedup is keyed by (account_id, idempotency_key, timestamp_window). If header missing on retry, dedup fails and we double count.
 jae-sre: Short term mitigation: route to always preserve both `Idempotency-Key` and `X-Idempotency-Key` from client headers, and make the ingress queued/fast-path copy code path preserve headers. I can hotfix edge config to treat the header as an allowed pass-through. Also add a fast metric: `ingress.replay.missing_idempotency 1` when a replay is observed without that header.
 matt_ops: I can push a small patch to the ingress proxy today. The bug is in commit `edge-proxy:542` where we normalize headers during the retry handoff. Quick diff (conceptual):
 ```diff
 -   replay_req.headers = strip_internal_headers(orig)
 +   replay_req.headers = preserve_idempotency_headers(orig)
 ```
 sophia-engr: For longer term: we should change metering dedup key to also include a deterministic request fingerprint (sha256 of body + route + client_id) as a secondary dedup. That will handle cases where header is lost by network. But that requires us to keep a short-lived fingerprint cache (24h) — ops implications.
 tara-support: Customer asked for refund. Billing approved a manual refund for the duplicate invoice lines and we credited 11,980 tokens back. Customer still wants RCA and a repro path so they can be confident it won't recur.
 eli: Repro steps for infra team:
 1) send request with `X-Idempotency-Key` and cause edge to return 504 (simulate by dropping upstream) on first attempt
 2) trigger sdk auto-retry
 3) confirm second downstream call arrives without header on fast-path handoff
 4) check ledger: two usage events written for same request_id but different idempotency value (null)
 Use this helper script to simulate (run against staging-edge):
 ```bash
 # simulate first request failing then client retry
 for i in 1 2; do 
   curl -s -H "X-Idempotency-Key: test-replay-$$" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://staging-edge.test/v1/generate &
   sleep 0.5
 done
 ```
 jae-sre: I'll add the `ingress.replay.missing_idempotency` metric and a tracing annotation `replay.header_mismatch=true` so we can query traces for this pattern. Also will add an alert if we see >5 such events in 10m for a single account.
 matt_ops: Patch deployed to canary edge at 2026-03-12T18:20Z; verified in staging with the repro script: idempotency header preserved on both flows. Rolling to prod now.
 billing-bot: Refund applied: credit_78921 processed. Customer notified by tara-support.
 tara-support: Customer confirmed refund and accepts the RCA. They'll re-open if they see it again. Closing the support escalation. :white_check_mark:
